appraisal_events.evidence: il affectait d'ignorer tout ce qui concernait le monde... Mais voyons, mon chéri, tu sais bien, dit sa mère, c'est la sœur de Vermandois; c'est elle qui t'avait donné ce beau jeu de billard que tu aimais tant.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator exposes Robert's studied pose of indifference to society as affectation: his mother's immediate correction reveals he in fact knows Mme de Saint-Ferréol well, undercutting his performed detachment from 'le monde'.

status_effects.explanation: Robert's pretended ignorance of society is exposed as insincere posturing once his mother reminds him of his actual familiarity with the person in question.
